content.text:
**Root cause found and fixed:** `@pantoken/interactions/interactions.iife.js` only exposes the behavior *functions* — it has no `DOMContentLoaded` auto-init side effects. Auto-wiring for a component comes only from that component's own per-component IIFE (`tabs.iife.js`, `modal.iife.js`, etc.), listed per-component in `component-capabilities.json`.

Fixed [main.ts.tmpl](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl#L32) to load `button.iife.js`, `tray.iife.js`, `tabs.iife.js`, and `modal.iife.js` (the ones actually used by `app.html`'s chrome) instead of the inert `interactions.iife.js`. Rebuilt the scaffold package and the canvas-rce docs bundle, then verified in-browser: clicking a tab now correctly toggles `aria-selected` and swaps the `hidden` panel.

Note: every other scaffold template (react, vue, svelte, angular, next, web-components, components) and the exported `theme.js` builder (`platforms/canvas-theme-editor/src/build-theme.ts`) have the same `interactions.iife.js`-only import with a misleading "wires up behaviors out of the box" comment — same latent bug, not yet fixed since it was out of scope for this request. Let me know if you'd like those addressed too.
interactions.iife.js should be all component interactions so you don't have to import individual ones.

Confirmed working end-to-end: both the app's own chrome (single `interactions.iife.js` script) and the generated `theme.js` for real Canvas pages now correctly auto-wire tabs — clicking `#tab-js` toggled `aria-selected` and swapped the visible panel.

Summary of the fix:
- [formats/interactions/scripts/build-iife.ts](formats/interactions/scripts/build-iife.ts#L54) now builds `interactions.iife.js` from a generated entry that re-exports the manual API (`src/index.ts`) **and** imports every component's auto-init side-effect module, instead of just `src/index.ts` alone.
- Reverted [main.ts.tmpl](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl#L32) back to the single `interactions.iife.js` import.
- Rebuilt `@pantoken/interactions` and the canvas-rce docs bundle; verified in-browser that tabs, and by extension every other `.instui-*` component, auto-wire from the one script.
